description: Machine-readable source of truth for feature status. The scheduler picks the lowest-priority feature that is not 'passing'; the verifier gates the transition to 'passing'. See docs/harness/README.md.

status_legend.blocked: Cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved (see notes).
status_legend.passing: Required verification has run and evidence is recorded. Irreversible without a documented regression.

baselines.backend: go build ./... && make check  (go vet + golangci-lint + go test -race -shuffle=on ./...)
baselines.web: cd web && npm run build && npm test
baselines.end_to_end: ./deploy/smoke.sh  (stack up; assert gateway healthy, scripted kill triggers self-heal, dome closes; tear down)

features.title: Walking skeleton — one task auctioned & completed end-to-end
features.user_visible_behavior: A single task flows core -> NATS -> state -> gateway -> screen: it is auctioned, awarded as a lease, and completed, visible on the dashboard.
verification: make check (backend suite green)
./deploy/smoke.sh reaches a connected gateway and the stack runs end-to-end
evidence: make check green @ fedd919 (vet ok, golangci-lint 0 issues, go test -race ./... all ok, go1.25.5)
./deploy/smoke.sh PASS — stack healthy, runs end-to-end
features.notes: Built and merged. E2E path is asserted by deploy/smoke.sh.

features.title: Rovers move & drain battery; cost function
features.user_visible_behavior: Rovers move toward awarded tasks, drain battery, and bid using a distance/battery/capability/load cost function.
verification: go test -race ./internal/agent/... ./internal/core/allocation/...
evidence: make check green @ fedd919 (internal/agent, internal/core/allocation tests ok)

features.title: Self-heal core — heartbeat, expiry, re-auction
features.user_visible_behavior: A silent rover's lease expires exactly once and its task returns to UNCLAIMED for re-auction, with no supervisory logic and no Earth intervention.
verification: go test -race ./internal/core/lease/... ./internal/coordinator/...
smoke.sh asserts 'msg=expiry task=wall-1 ... returned to UNCLAIMED'
evidence: make check green @ fedd919 (internal/core/lease, internal/coordinator tests ok)
./deploy/smoke.sh PASS — 'msg=expiry task=wall-1 ... returned to UNCLAIMED' then dome-cap complete
features.notes: The entire product pitch. Self-heal = expiry + re-auction.

features.title: Kill control — live headline
features.user_visible_behavior: An operator kills a rover mid-task from the dashboard and the worksite reorganises live.
verification: go test -race ./internal/killer/... ./internal/agent/...
evidence: make check green @ fedd919 (internal/killer, internal/agent tests ok); KILL modelled as recoverable in-place outage (4a990fa, 3c18a39)

features.title: Habitat dome blueprint + 5-6 rover swarm
features.user_visible_behavior: A dome blueprint decomposes into foundation/wall/cap tasks with dependencies; a 5-6 rover swarm builds it and the dome closes (dome-cap DONE).
verification: go test -race ./internal/core/planner/... ./internal/core/world/...
smoke.sh asserts 'msg=complete task=dome-cap'
evidence: make check green @ fedd919 (internal/core/planner, internal/core/world tests ok)
./deploy/smoke.sh PASS — 'msg=complete task=dome-cap' (dome closed)

manual: run make demo and watch the beats land in order
evidence: make check green @ fedd919 (internal/demo tests ok)

verification: cd web && npm run build && npm test
manual: 3D scene renders and re-renders cleanly on snapshot updates
evidence: WEB=1 ./init.sh green @ fedd919 (vite build TS-clean, vitest 7 files / 60 tests pass); 3D renderer code-split into a lazy chunk (c980b64); demand-driven re-render-free scene (cdf8246)
features.notes: HITL/visual slice. Re-run web baseline (WEB=1 ./init.sh) when touching web/.

features.title: Container encore (stretch)
features.user_visible_behavior: A rover runs as a genuinely separate system (pod-per-rover); a real kubectl delete kills it and the swarm heals over the bus.
verification: manual: pod-per-rover k8s mode, kubectl-delete a rover, observe heal; ./deploy/smoke.sh for the compose path
evidence: pod-per-rover Kubernetes mode with real kubectl-delete kills (e3cc5e3); in-dashboard reload + auto port-forward (ca0ff34)

features.title: Build-spec seam + renderer interpreter + fallback (no LLM)
features.user_visible_behavior: A Build spec (declarative build operations) is carried in the Task snapshot and the renderer interprets it into geometry; a deterministic fallback spec exists so the scene renders with no LLM in the loop.
verification: go test -race ./... (new build-spec module green)
cd web && npm run build && npm test (renderer interprets a spec, falls back when none)
./deploy/smoke.sh still passes — invariant: no harness call on the award/lease/expiry path; worst failure is 'looks like today', never 'demo breaks'
features.notes: First active slice of the build-harness roadmap. Must respect ADR-0005..0007 and ADR-0001..0004. Build spec is declarative DATA, never executed code (ADR-0006).

features.title: Streamed, durable, resumable build ops (no LLM)
features.user_visible_behavior: Build ops stream into the snapshot and are durable + resumable across a rover outage (ADR-0007), still with no LLM.
verification: go test -race ./... ; ./deploy/smoke.sh still passes; manual: interrupt mid-build and confirm resume from durable ops

features.title: Model seam + one provider; bake one spec
features.user_visible_behavior: Behind the Model seam, one LLM provider generates a single Build spec offline ('bake'); swapping the provider is a config change, not a harness change.
verification: go test -race ./... (model seam unit-tested with a fake provider; validate-and-repair + fallback-on-exhaustion)

go test -race ./... includes an import-graph architecture test asserting internal/harness/model is NOT in the import closure of the hot-path packages (allocation/auction, lease/heartbeat, expiry, tick) — ADR-0005
manual: bake one spec and render it; confirm no API key reaches the browser
evidence: internal/harness/model: Model interface + openai-go/v3 adapter (provider/base_url/model/key config); FakeModel contract test proves validate-and-repair (re-ask once) and fallback-on-exhaustion (model_test.go, no network)
internal/harness/archtest: import-graph test asserts internal/harness/model NOT in the closure of allocation/lease/world/planner/coordinator — `go list -deps`, skips if go absent (ADR-0005)

cmd/bake + internal/harness/bake: live gpt-4o-2024-08-06 bake produced 6-op foundation-1 spec → internal/harness/cache/specs/dome_foundation-1_3ae7e393_gpt-4o-2024-08-06.json (committed, declarative data, no key)

headline replay: demo Rovers carry BlueprintID; embedded go:embed cache → deterministic replay (cache_test + coordinator/replay_test: hit replays baked spec, forced miss falls back to primitive, Task still DONE)
smoke (Docker): self-heal fired + dome closed; live WS snapshot foundation-1 carried the exact baked spec, status DONE
make check green: vet + golangci-lint (0 issues) + go test -race -shuffle=on ./...; go mod tidy clean; .env gitignored (only .env.example committed)
features.notes: HITL. The vendor SDK lives behind a single narrow interface (Model seam). The import-graph test mechanically enforces the hot-path invariant (promotes the TECHSPEC §8 grep). Done in bh-03 worktree.

features.title: Generator <-> Evaluator loop + layered verdict (hard gate + soft rubric) + trace; bake all
features.user_visible_behavior: A Build harness runs a generate->evaluate loop until a contract's 'done' is met, baking specs for all tasks. The Evaluator emits a hard gate (envelope/collision/done — boolean, blocking) plus a soft rubric (done-coverage/coherence, 0-2 + evidence); each bake writes a trace sidecar.
verification: go test -race ./... (generator/evaluator loop; hard gate rejects out-of-envelope/collision/unmet-done with a unit test on each)
go test -race ./... (a hard-gate-passing but low-scoring spec is cached with quality_flag:low, not withheld; the <spec-key>.trace.json round-trips)
manual: bake-all produces a coherent dome; operator review lists fell-back UNION quality_flag:low Tasks
features.notes: Topology (B): Generator+Evaluator in one harness now. Layered verdict + trace per ADR-0008; the quality_flag:low population is the inspectable trigger for sub-agents (C) later (see memory: build-harness-agent-topology).

features.title: Drag-to-place + Architect contracts + palette
features.user_visible_behavior: An operator drags items from a palette; the Architect authors Build contracts (intent + 'done') per task, within a Build envelope.
verification: cd web && npm run build && npm test ; go test -race ./... ; manual: drag-to-place produces composable, non-overlapping geometry
features.notes: Parallel branch off bh-02. Architect authors intent; the Auction still owns who/when (untouched).

features.title: Vision evaluator pass + provider-swap proof
features.user_visible_behavior: A vision-based evaluator judges rendered output (headless Chrome on the real Scene3D) and a second provider is swapped in to prove the Model seam holds.
verification: go test -race ./... ; manual: vision score populates the silhouette soft-rubric dimension (0-2 + evidence) and lands in the trace; a low score refines within budget but on exhaustion the spec still caches flagged quality_flag:low (never withheld — ADR-0008)
manual: run the same bake under two providers (GPT-class, Gemini OpenAI-compat) via config only; specs still validate (validate-and-repair retained)
features.notes: HITL. The vision pass is the source of the silhouette rubric dimension (couples bh-06 to bh-04's Evaluator). Bake/lab only — zero vision calls on the headline path.

features.title: Stretch — live lab mode, sub-agents (C), glTF + textures
features.user_visible_behavior: A live lab mode runs the deep generation loop with sub-agents and richer assets (glTF models + textures) without changing the seam.
verification: go test -race ./... ; cd web && npm run build && npm test ; manual: lab-mode generation renders custom models/textures
features.notes: Stretch. Deep loop lives in the generation/lab path; the headline replays a cached spec (see memory: build-harness-agent-topology).
